tools.name: get-statistics
tools.description: All heat pump entities that provide statistics data, such as total energy input and output, number of compressor starts, or operating times, etc.

tools.name: get-temperatures
tools.description: All heat pump entities that provide temperature measurements or derived measured values, such as the damped outdoor temperature, or temperature settings. Temperature measurements include, for example, the flow temperature in the refrigeration circuit, primary circuit, or heating circuit, the air inlet temperature at the evaporator, or the outdoor temperature. Temperature settings include, for example, desired room temperature or the start temperature for domestic hot water.

tools.name: get-states
tools.description: All entities describing the current state of the heat pump, e.g., compressor operating state, valve position, etc.

tools.name: get-settings
tools.description: All entities for heat pump settings, e.g., heating limit, desired room temperature, etc.

tools.name: get-pumps
tools.description: All heat pump entities that provide data on the installed pumps, such as the current flow rate of the primary circuit pump PC0 or the current modulation of the heating circuit pump PC1.

tools.name: get-eheater
tools.description: All entities related to the electric auxiliary heater, e.g., energy consumption, current status of the heating element, etc.
